reason: The weighty bills are exactly what the statement names: plastic bag levy (1, 17), climate law (4, 6, 10, 15), protection of mature trees (3), coastal protection (9, 14, 25), plus wildlife, trawling ban, recycling duties, clean air and the Basic Law on the environment. All are labeled toward and all tighten environmental rules at a cost to businesses or consumers, so the price clause is honest. Light off-topic rows (environmental investment considerations for pension funds and the public guardian, environmental reports by government companies) are about disclosure and investment, not regulation, and carry little weight.
